title: Group Fitness Class Passes: deducting outstanding no-show charges from a pack refund
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states how an outstanding no-show charge already on a pack's history reduces the refund amount before that refund is finalized.

## Applicable condition
Any no-show fee amounts already recorded in this pack's history that have not otherwise been offset are deducted once from that refund amount before adjustment. Where this pack's history carries no such outstanding amount, no deduction is made and the refund amount before adjustment carries forward unchanged.

## Basis
Before this pack's refund is finalized, the sum of every such fee amount already logged against the pack's history that has not otherwise been offset is subtracted once from the refund amount reached at that point. The subtraction is applied only once, regardless of how many separate charges make up that sum, and the resulting figure is never carried below zero — where the sum of outstanding charges would otherwise exceed the refund amount, the floor stops the deduction at zero rather than producing a negative figure.

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, the refund amount reached before this deduction were $45.00, and this pack's history already carried two such unoffset fee charges of $15.00 and $20.00 (a combined $35.00). The deduction reduces the refund to $10.00. Had the combined outstanding charges instead been $60.00, the deduction would stop at zero rather than produce a negative refund.

## Points of judgement
- Only amounts "not otherwise offset" are counted; a charge already accounted for elsewhere is not deducted a second time here.
- The floor at zero applies to this deduction step specifically, before any further adjustment to the refund is considered.
